GenAiFunction.description:
Use this action to approve or reject claims using their claim numbers.
Inputs: - claimNumbers: A list of claim numbers (e.g., WC-123, WC-456) - action: Specify whether to "approve" or "reject" the claims - approvedAmount: Required only when approving claims
Behavior: - If action is "approve": - The claim status is updated to "Approved" - The approved amount is set on the claim - If action is "reject": - The claim status is updated to "Rejected" - Any existing approved amount is cleared
Rules: - Always ensure claim numbers are provided - Ask the user for approved amount if approving and amount is missing - Do not ask for amount when rejecting - Confirm user intent before performing bulk actions
Output: - Returns list of processed claim numbers - Returns count of updated claims - Returns a confirmation message
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: Approve or Reject Claims by Claim Number
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Processing your request to approve or reject claims. Please wait...
